text: Entry 1007 removes DTSTART from the recurring CANCEL fixture and leaves an X-NOTE that documents the omission. The current unprocessed-cancel test expects all toolbar actions hidden. A separate exception-only series test loads the same cancellation, shows Delete, removes the stored event and checks no reply was sent. The fixture reaches meaningful invitation consumers rather than merely checking that parsing does not throw. Both tests were inspected but not run.
title: Use an incomplete cancellation fixture to verify both unprocessed and stored-series paths
